A man's voice, outside: "What's taking so long in there? Right. I'm coming in myself."
You walked all the way out here to see an old man and a lamp. Well. I'm Tiberio. I keep the lamp, and I'll
thank you not to touch it.
What do you see from up there?
The sea, mostly. Same as yesterday, same as tomorrow. The sky's better. I've seen it go red, and one night
it rained stars till morning. Galeazzo at the observatory writes it all down in his little book.
